prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `Notebook`, `NotebookState`, `NotebookGateway`, and `NotebookRowController`. A notebook has readonly `id`, `title`, and nullable `summary`. State contains a nullable selected ID, a readonly notebook list, and a boolean `saving`. The controller receives a notebook, workspace ID, state getter, dispatch callback, and gateway. `icon()` returns `complete` when the summary is a non-empty trimmed string and `draft` otherwise. `select()` dispatches `{ type: "select"; id }` only when state.saving is false. `rename(title)` trims the title, rejects empty titles with `RangeError`, calls `gateway.rename(workspaceId, notebookId, title)`, then awaits `gateway.list(workspaceId)` and dispatches one `replace` action containing fresh copies. `remove()` similarly calls remove, refreshes, and dispatches replace. If the removed notebook was selected, it must then dispatch select with null. Gateway failures propagate and produce no dispatch. Inputs and gateway results must not be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
